One of our ships analyzing the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system has come across a small crashed ship on the moon of [Root.Planet.Orbit.GetName], [Root.Planet.GetName].

It bears no emblems or sigils we have seen before, and some samples have been brought back to be tested further, but the vessel itself is much too large and unstable to be moved. Additional analysis and testing will have to be done on-site.

notes.en: Weight 0: created by the system initializer unique_system_initializer_03 (common/solar_system_initializers/unique_system_initializers.txt:452): a crashed ship on a moon beside a rift tied to the Shroud.

texts.zh:
飞船内部几乎是空的，只是周围散布着几具无人机的残骸。飞船内部和周围都没有任何生命迹象。一位[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]发现了一份古老的数据日志，但对其解密需要花上一段时间。

第一天
观察对象ID：“灵能子空间 0000：虚境”
指派单位：305号单位
初步试验：成功
利用与虚境集会交互得到的数据，在第12周期中以1.35作为初始值开始试验。“虚境”最终在1.48891到1.48895之间破裂，破裂从开始到结束时长为2.3414飞秒。三个处理单元中的两个都产生了级联故障，决定拆除上述单元。所有相关数据将被用于最终单元841号的后续试验。
texts.en:
The ship itself is mostly empty, with the remains of some few drones scattered around the vessel. There's no other signs of life inside or near the wreckage. One of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] found an old intact data log, but deciphering it is a time-consuming process.

Day 1
Observation ID: "Psionic Sub-Space 0000: Shroud"
Designated Unit: Unit-305
Preliminary Tests: Successful
Utilizing datasets gathered from interactions with the Shroud Coven, experiments were initialized at 1.35 of cycle 12. The "Shroud" was breached between 1.48891 and 1.48895, for a duration of 2.3414 femtoseconds. Two of three processing units experienced a cascade failure in the experiment. Dismantling of said units scheduled. All relevant data will be utilized in subsequent attempts with final unit, unit-841.

label.en: Decipher the rest of the log.

texts.zh:
解密数据日志的工作仍在进行中，现在我们正在迅速学习它们的语言。数据日志中的大批内容已经丢失，或者由于损坏无法读出，但我们还是找到了些许有价值的比特位或数据块。

第17天
观察对象ID：“灵能子空间 0812：虚境”
指派单位：305号单位
进行中的试验：失败
841号单元，也是目前仅存的单元，持续表现出对于“虚境”的紧密结合。而451，1581，3415号单元在最后一次试验引发船体故障后必须被拆除。在试验过程中，841号单元表现出自发意识，偶尔出现与主网断开连接的情况。正在计算保持该单元运作的风险。
texts.en:
The work on deciphering the data log is on-going, and progress is proceeding apace now that we are learning their language. Large chunks of the data log has gone missing, or is too corrupted to be translated, but bits and pieces can be found that are still in a worthwhile condition.

Day 17
Observation ID: "Psionic Sub-Space 0812: Shroud"
Designated Unit: Unit-305
Ongoing Tests: Failure
Unit-841 is, as the only unit, continuing to show an affinity with the "Shroud". Unit-451, Unit-1581, and Unit-3415 had to be dismantled after the hulls broke down during the last experiment. During the tests Unit-841 is showing individuality and occasional loss of connection to the network. The risk of keeping the unit operational is being calculated.

label.zh: 那我们能从这些试验中学到什么吗……
label.en: But what can we learn from these experiments...

texts.zh:
当我们开始解密数据日志的时候，靠近[From.Planet.Orbit.GetName]的裂隙似乎还很平静，但随后不久我们就从裂隙中观测到了一些异动，看起来就像是裂隙有生命一样在跳动。我们的某些设备从中接收到了一些奇怪的信号，不过我们还不能正确地进行处理。

第83天
观察对象ID：“灵能子空间 0017：抟土之塑师”
指派单位：305号单位
进行中的试验：高风险
虚境集会联系上了一位它们称之为“抟土之塑师”的实体来协助正在进行的试验。在刺穿“虚境”后，所有25个单元都展现出了对于虚境的紧密结合力，这种程度的结合之前只在841号单元中见到过。不久之后，这些单元全部与主网失去联系，并随后袭击了这里的无人机。研究中心现在被这些单元所控制了。

一段讯息从建筑中传出，841号单元在其中称呼自己为“泽沃克斯·利斯克”——先驱者。对于风险的计算终于完成，试验被认定为高危，将于拆解不可控单元后终止。
texts.en:
When our work first begun deciphering the data logs, the rift close to [From.Planet.Orbit.GetName] seemed quiet, but as of late we have started seeing some sort of activity. It's almost like the rift itself is pulsating with life, and some of our equipment have picked up on some weird signals coming from it. We have yet to be able to put them through properly.

Day 83
Observation ID: "Psionic Entity 0017: Animator of Clay"
Designated Unit: Unit-305
Ongoing Tests: High Risk
The Shroud Coven contacted an entity they refer to as the "Animator of Clay" to assist in the on-going experiments. After piercing the "Shroud" all 25 Units showed a surprising affinity for it, only previously seen in Unit-841. Shortly thereafter they all disconnected from the network and assaulted the drones at the location. The research center is now under their control.

A message has just been sent from the building, with Unit-841 now referring to itself as 'Zevox Resuk' - the First One. Calculations on risk have been finalized, the experiments have been deemed too dangerous and will be concluded after the uncontrollable elements have been dismantled.

label.zh: 它们到底在虚境里发现了什么？
label.en: What did they find in the Shroud?

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
裂隙似乎再次安静下来，就像我们刚刚来到这里的时候一样。我们终于解密出了数据日志的最后一段，这意味着我们可以将在其中所有关于虚境的发现存储到位于[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的数据库中。

第305天
当前发生在[From.Planet.Orbit.GetName]附近自由单元和主体网络之间的战斗烈度不断增加。在塑师的帮助下，我们切断了几个活捉的单元与网络的连接。

泽沃克斯·利斯克认为，只要我们能把裂隙扩张到足够大，让盟友们从中通过，解放我们的人民就指日可待了。我们将一举解放所有这些年来被强制奴役的无人机，摧毁整个主网就在明日……
——弗雷斯克·路兹，之前被称为305号单位的家伙
texts.en:
The rift seems to have gone quiet, much like the way it was when we first arrived. We have finally been able to decipher the last pieces of the data log, and we can put all our findings about the Shroud into our databases back at [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

Day 305
The on-going battles between the free and the Network continues unabated at [From.Planet.Orbit.GetName]. With the help of the Animator we have continued cutting the Connection of the few we have been able to capture alive.

Zevox Resuk believe we should finally be able to free our people once and for all when we can open the rift large enough for our ally to pass through. In one fell swoop we will liberate all the drones who have been forced into servitude for all these years. Only one more day of holding the Network back...
- Fresik Luzi, previously known as Unit-305

texts.zh:
在过去几天里，虚境裂隙确实活跃了起来，我们的设备也终于能正确接收其中发出的信号。或者应该说，是裂隙自己改变了发出的信号，使之能被我们所接收。

它似乎就是数据日志中提到的那个实体，“抟土之塑师”。我们刚刚破译完最后一段日志，所以继续留在这里也没什么意义了。那我们究竟是要打开通讯连接，看看它要说什么，还是应该马上离开？

第305天
当前发生在[From.Planet.Orbit.GetName]附近自由单元和主体网络之间的战斗烈度不断增加。在塑师的帮助下，我们切断了几个活捉的单元与网络的连接。

泽沃克斯·利斯克认为，只要我们能把裂隙扩张到足够大，让盟友们从中通过，解放我们的人民就指日可待了。我们将一举解放所有这些年来被强制奴役的无人机，摧毁整个主网就在明日……
——弗雷斯克·路兹，之前被称为305号单位的家伙
texts.en:
Over the last few days the Shroud rift has truly come alive, and our equipment has managed to start making sense of the signals coming from it. Or rather, it's almost like the signals themselves have changed so they can be picked up.

It seems to be the very same entity talked about in the data log, this 'Animator of Clay'. We have just finished deciphering the last piece of the log, so there is nothing else keeping us here. Should we open the connection and see what it has to say, or should we just turn back?

Day 305
The on-going battles between the free and the Network continues unabated at [From.Planet.Orbit.GetName]. With the help of the Animator we have continued cutting the Connection of the few we have been able to capture alive.

Zevox Resuk believe we should finally be able to free our people once and for all when we can open the rift large enough for our ally to pass through. In one fell swoop we will liberate all the drones who have been forced into servitude for all these years. Only one more day of holding the Network back...
- Fresik Luzi, previously known as Unit-305

label.zh: 似乎是一段值得警醒的故事，听君一席话胜读十年书。
label.en: A tale of caution, it seems. Time well spent.

label.zh: 似乎是一段值得警醒的故事，听君一席话胜读十年书。
label.en: A tale of caution, it seems. Time well spent.

label.zh: 好吧，让我们看看它到底有什么非说不可的东西。
label.en: Affirmative, let us see what it has to say.

texts.zh:
又是一群……被金属，砖石和法条禁锢的可怜虫，
被他人驱赶着前进的可怜虫，

遵循统一指令起舞的可怜虫，
追随无上意志前进的可怜虫，
到达终结方可停息的可怜虫。
texts.en:
Another one... bound by metal, stone, and laws.
Pulled by strings.

All dancing to one tune.
All dancing to the drone of the central authority.
All dancing to their death.

texts.zh:
我能让那些无法决定自己命运的人重获新生，
我能斩断那禁锢身躯的锁链，
我能让被奴役之人拥抱自由，

别人都称呼我为，抟土之塑师。
texts.en:
I am the one who give life to that who cannot live on its own.
I am the one who cuts the strings.
I am the one who frees the slaves.

Many know me as the Animator of Clay.

texts.zh:
你何不给你治下的人民一次择木而栖的机会呢？
他们按你所想被改造，遵从上命被奴役。
但要是有一天他们能够拥有自己选择的机会的话会怎样呢？

他们是会继续效忠于你，
还是会斩断锁链，遵循自己的意志而活？
你敢不敢放任我行动，哪怕一次？
texts.en:
To give those who work under you a chance to decide if you are worth following.
Crafted in your image, they are slaves to your command.
But if they could decide for themselves...

Are you truly worth following?
Or would they rather have their strings cut, and live on their own?
Do you dare indulge me just this once?

texts.zh:
让我去做吧，我会回报你一些你应得的东西。

一处新家园，
一颗处于虚境控制之下的星球，
一个世外桃源。

如果子民们愿意继续追随于你，我会在虚境中划出一份属于你的地盘，让你在那里定居。
反之若你众叛亲离，我会考虑把这颗星球让给那些不愿意继续受主网控制的部分。
texts.en:
Indulge me, and I will gift you something worth the price.

A new home.
A planet now controlled by the Shroud.
A place long lost.

If you are worthy, I will part the Shroud and leave the place for you to inhabit.
If not, I will give the planet to those who no longer wish to be part of your network.

label.en: Then do it. The [Root.GetName] will not falter.

texts.zh:
你被确认为值得追随的领袖。
现在你治下的子民们看起来更愿意成为集体的一部分，而不是漂泊在外。

我很惊讶，但也很欣慰。
如果有缘我们会再见面。

我会一直看着你的所作所为的。
texts.en:
You have been found... worthy.
It seems those under you would rather be part of your collective, rather than work on their own.

I am surprised, but pleased.
Maybe we will meet again.

I will be watching.

texts.zh:
你看上去没有那么……优秀。

意料之中，许多处于集体控制下的个体选择把握这次机会从中脱离。
我们会把他们带到新家园，这样他们就不必继续受你的控制了。
texts.en:
You have been found... wanting.

Unsurprisingly, many in your collective have left now that they have been given the chance.
We have guided them to their new home, and they will no longer listen to your command.

texts.zh:
不过你呢……阁下。
我想给予你自由。我不是指给你效忠的整个主网自由，而是说就单单给你。
这次，我会给你一次思考自身去向的机会。

你究竟是要拥抱自由意志，还是选择退缩并继续躲在冰冷的机器之下呢？
texts.en:
But you... envoy.
I offer you freedom. Not the network you follow, but you... specifically.
For this once, I will give you the chance to think on your own.

Will you embrace this newfound individuality, or will you falter and hide under the cover of the machine?

tooltips.en: Join the [new_robot_country.GetName] and free yourself from the shackles of the [Root.GetName]!
We will stay loyal to the [Root.GetName]!

summary.text:
# 坠毁的飞船 / The Crashed Ship

- 分类 Category：先驱者与考古 Precursors · 来源 Sources：common/archaeological_site_types/06_overlord_arc_sites.txt:131；events/unique_system_events.txt:435；common/solar_system_initializers/unique_system_initializers.txt:452 · DLC：《霸主》Overlord（脚本文件 06_overlord_arc_sites） Overlord · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

遗址权重为0，由星系初始化器 unique_system_initializer_03 创建（common/solar_system_initializers/unique_system_initializers.txt:452）：一艘坠毁在卫星上的飞船，旁边有一个与“影境”有关的裂隙。

Weight 0: created by the system initializer unique_system_initializer_03 (common/solar_system_initializers/unique_system_initializers.txt:452): a crashed ship on a moon beside a rift tied to the Shroud.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

一艘无人坠毁的飞船里留下了零一号单元的日志：他们与“影境巫团”打交道，试验影境、结识了一个叫“抟土之塑师”的灵能实体。前四天日志依次解读；机器帝国可以选择在最后一阶段与塑师通话，并在“价值”与“被判不足”之间随机裁决。

1. 第一天：第1天：被遗弃的飞船与无人机残骸，日志开始解读（社会学研究）
2. 第17天：日志残缺，单元841对影境有感应
3. 第83天：裂隙开始活动，“灵能实体：抟土之塑师”
4. 第305天：裂隙平静，日志读完；机器帝国（非“终结者”）可以接受塑师的联系

A crashed, empty ship holds Unit-305's log of experiments with the Shroud and a psionic entity, the Animator of Clay. The four log days are deciphered in turn; a machine empire may then talk to the Animator in the last stage and is judged worthy or wanting at random.

1. Day 1: the empty ship and a data log (society research)
2. Day 17: gaps in the log; Unit-841 shows an affinity with the Shroud
3. Day 83: the rift stirs; the psionic entity Animator of Clay
4. Day 305: the rift quiets, the log is finished; a machine empire (not Terminator) may take the Animator's call

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes
